campaign.context: Over 200 typedream.app subdomains spoof Ledger, Trezor, Bybit, MetaMask, and KuCoin via wallet-setup and login paths to harvest seed phrases. Subdomain labels embed target brand names alongside randomized strings to defeat blocklists. Reporters phishunt_io and skocherhan flagged 201 IOCs between 2026-08-16 and 2026-08-19.
campaign.name: Crypto phishing targeting Binance, Ledger, Trezor and Bybit
